title: Connect Store pending issue
content:
Hi, I'm new here and trying to upload my design to the Connect Store—how long does "Pending" usually take? Mine seems stuck.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: When I open the connect page, the upload tab doesn't appear.
Reply 1: Hi Joao, is this a screenshot from a phone? Uploading isn't possible this way.

Comment 2: When I open the connect page, the upload tab doesn't appear.

Comment 3: I think the long "pending" is caused by a problem with the item being uploaded, usually there will be a notification sent from the website for details of the problem.

Comment 4: Hi. From Friday to Sunday, the checking and uploading of designs will not be carried out by the site. Evaluations will resume starting from Monday
content_description: This page provides guidance and support for users experiencing delays with their design uploads in the Connect Store.
